findings.title: Moving the digit keys off freqTo drops the gun fit's 3/4/5 NO LASER cue and breaks key-path tests that §14.1's grep misses
findings.claim: After R1-F1's fix, keyboard Digit3/4/5 write only `freqKeyTo`, and §9 says it is 'read only on a class with a laser'. `freqTo` now comes only from the console buttons. Today the Valkyrn gun fit's Flight seat flashes NO LASER when `k.freqTo` is set by 3/4/5 (Valkyrn spec §6.1, its review R1-F2). Read literally, the new text never reads `freqKeyTo` there, so pressing 3/4/5 on the Valkyrn goes silent. That breaks the 'Valkyrn's Flight seat keeps theirs' promise at spec L444-445. valkyrnRuntime's test still passes because it injects `freqTo` directly, so nothing catches the loss. Also, scienceInput.test.ts asserts that Digit3/Digit5 keydowns set `freqTo`, and those asserts now fail. §14.1's inventory grep has no `freqTo`/`FREQ_CODES` term, so this file isn't covered by any rule.
findings.evidence: spec L444-445, L473-474 ('Read only on a class with a laser'), L479, L482-484; runtime.ts:L453 (`else if (requests.noLaser || (k.freqTo !== undefined && k.freqTo !== null) || …) refuse('laser', NO_LASER)   // §6.1: 1 or 3/4/5 on the gun fit`); input.ts:L146; tests/valkyrnRuntime.test.ts:L127-134 (holds `{ freqTo: 1 }` to stand in for 3/4/5); tests/scienceInput.test.ts:L38-44 (Digit3/Digit5 keydowns expect `sample().freqTo`); spec L810 (§14.1 grep pattern: laserLock|laserFire|laserCharge|laserMode|laserReleases|WeaponSlot.Beam|todaysCrewWeapons).
findings.why: This is a quiet regression of a pinned Valkyrn cue that the existing test can't detect. The scienceInput failures will turn up red during W-4a with no rule in §14.1 telling the subagent what to do with them.
findings.fix: In §9, say that the gun fit's Flight seat refuses NO LASER on `freqKeyTo ?? freqTo` (runtime.ts L453 reads both), and change valkyrnRuntime's test to hold `freqKeyTo`. Add `freqTo`/`FREQ_CODES` to §14.1's grep, and list scienceInput.test.ts as a port: key asserts move to `freqKeyTo`, the console `ui.frequency` asserts stay on `freqTo`, and new asserts cover Digit4-6 → `gunFreqKeyTo` and Digit1-3/Numpad1-3 → `selectTo`, including the clear/clearUi and repeat cases.

prior.note: §9 L471-486 adds separate freqKeyTo/gunFreqKeyTo/selectTo KeySample fields with class-based reading, and the §14 test at L729-731 pins that 3 on the Hound queues no laserFrequency. A side effect on the gun fit's cue is raised as a new P2.

§11 L566-579 defines the prediction as the thrMille analogue (k = unackedFrames capped, replica heading held fixed, latest turretAim, MAN traverse, explicit k=0 conditions, gunModeSent first). The §14 online tests at L787-790 are concrete and not vacuous.

§2.1 L97-102 adds pewShots/gunShots/holdEndTick/holdCause to DuelRun from the final state and the hostile event. tactical.hostileAt exists (hash.ts:L165) and the hostile event carries its cause (science.ts:L41).
§12 L593-596 gives the sparesOf/capacityOf/autocannon-at-0 pre-check, and §14 L797-799 names the kinds-list change as kind (a), including the W-4a stand-in's pewFire.
